aldrachi-reaver.title: Aldrachi Reaver notes

Throw {Reaver's Glaive} at the priority target and stack {Reaver's Mark} with the empowered {Fracture}

Rav'i: [탱버] This boss's only tank threats are Physical melee and the 3-hit Hydrastrike, so keep Demon Spikes up without gaps and add Fiery Brand if Hydrastrike lands while you are low.
[광역 피해] Drop Darkness for the party Nature damage of Ravenous Stomp.
[해제] Vengeance Demon Hunters cannot remove the Regurgitate disease, so leave it to a party member who can.
[위치] If the empty pile without Fresh Meat is far, Infernal Strike there first and drag the boss over.
The Writhing Coil: [탱버] Tail Scythe is a single 3 sec cast Physical hit, so pop Demon Spikes for the cast and add Fiery Brand only if your health is short.
[위치] Tank the boss near the edge of the room so Vindictive Onslaught aims at the wall, and put Disrupt into the Toxic Atrophy kick rotation (10 yd with Improved Disrupt).
[제어] During Uncoil, gather the 5 Uncoiled Writhes and hold them with Chaos Nova or Sigil of Misery, and cover their Toxic Atrophy at once with Sigil of Silence.
Zul'jan: [탱버] Pop Demon Spikes for the 2-hit Chop Down (484912 Physical each) and add Fiery Brand if you are low. Chop Down clears 2 stacks of Ritual Venom, so do not try to avoid it.
[광역 피해] Drop Darkness during the Ritual of the Fang beam soak channel.
[위치] If your beam spot is far, Infernal Strike there before Ritual of the Fang starts, and after Axegrinder drag the boss to the edge so blood pools stack on the outside.
[참고] Axegrinder axes ignore armor, so when you clip one to clear leftover stacks, only touch a slowed axe.

Lightblossom Trinity: [탱버] Bedrock Slam is 484912 Physical plus 193965 Nature, so mostly Physical. It comes right after the Lightblossom Beam soak ends; pop Demon Spikes then and stack Fiery Brand on top.
[위치] During Lightblossom Beam, step into the Fertile Loam near the boss to block the beam, then Infernal Strike out of the patch when the beam ends to take Bedrock Slam.
[차단] Kick Kezkitt's Light Bolt with Disrupt.
[참고] Drop Darkness when Bedrock Surge and Overgrowth party damage overlap.
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [위치] Before Verdant Stomp, drag the boss out of the root zone, and if the knockback pushes you away, Infernal Strike back next to the boss.
[해제] You cannot remove Bloodthorn Roots (Magic) from allies, so hit the roots with your AoE to break them fast.
[탱버] After 50% Lightcrazed Frenzy, Thorncaller Roar is Nature damage that Demon Spikes armor does not reduce, so use Fiery Brand or Metamorphosis.
[참고] Drop Darkness if Thorncaller Roar party damage gets dangerous.
Lightwarden Ruia: [탱버] During Bear Form Mangling Claws, keep Demon Spikes up without gaps and line up Fiery Brand.
[차단] Kick Moonkin Form Warden's Wrath with Disrupt. A missed Warden's Wrath is Nature damage that Demon Spikes armor does not reduce, so take it with Fiery Brand.
[탱버] The Grievous Thrash bleed only falls off at full health, so top off with the instant heal from Metamorphosis and Soul Cleave.
[탱버] After 40%, split Fiery Brand and Metamorphosis across the phase.
Ziekket: [탱버] The Thornspike hit is 193965 Holy, which Demon Spikes armor does not reduce, so use Fiery Brand, and Infernal Strike back after the knockback.
[위치] When Lashers spawn, drop Sigil of Flame in the middle of the adds and grab threat first with Immolation Aura.
[차단] Kick Lightspore Shot from Lashers before they revive with Disrupt or Sigil of Silence.
[회피] Clear Lasher slows with Vengeful Retreat (Wowhead).

The Hoardmonger: [참고] This boss has no big tank hit. Ravenous Bellow and Hearty Bellow are armor-ignoring party Physical damage, so line up Darkness with them and pop Fiery Brand if your own health is low.
[위치] Keep the boss in the middle of the room unless you are feeding a resource pile, and soak 3-4 mushrooms each time. Infernal Strike to far mushrooms to step on them within 12 sec.
[해제] Vengeance Demon Hunters cannot remove the Toxic Spores poison, so leave it to party members. 4 stacks are survivable (Topicx).
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Take Winter's Shroud on the Fractured Shivercore next to the boss with Disrupt, and cover the other add, handled by ranged, with Sigil of Silence (30 yd).
[탱버] If you take Frozen Tempest Frost damage outside Snowdrift, pop Fiery Brand and Metamorphosis. It is Frost damage, so Demon Spikes armor does not reduce it.
[참고] Drop Darkness when Glacial Torment and Winter's Shroud Frost damage overlap (Wowhead: Darkness is strong on almost every pull and boss in this dungeon).
Nalorakk: [탱버] Overwhelming Onslaught (armor-ignoring 315193 Physical × 3) hurts the most, so pop Fiery Brand and Metamorphosis for the cast. Fiery Brand lasts 12 sec and also covers the following Forceful Slam soak.
[위치] When the final hit knocks you back, Infernal Strike straight back within 6 yd of Zul'jarra to soak Forceful Slam (775859 Physical). Use Demon Spikes for this hit too.
[참고] If you are targeted by Echoing Maul, use the remaining Fiery Brand charge, and drop Darkness while bodying Echoes during Fury of the War God.

Kystia Manaheart: [탱버] Chaos Barrage (290947 Chaos) is not reduced by Demon Spikes armor and repeats all fight, so alternate the two Fiery Brand charges (48 sec each) to cover two or more hits in a row. If no charge is up, take it with Metamorphosis.
[차단] Kick one Mirror Image with Disrupt, and stop Felstorm on the grouped images with Chaos Nova or Sigil of Silence.
[광역 피해] Destabilized pulses Chaos damage on the party every second for 20 sec, so drop Darkness.
[해제] Corroding Spittle is Magic, which Vengeance Demon Hunters cannot remove, so leave it to the healer.
Zaen Bladesorrow: [탱버] Taunt the boss with Torment the moment it appears, and pop Metamorphosis because worker melee damage is heavy right after the pull (second Bloodlust).
[탱버] Stack Fiery Brand on Demon Spikes for Envenom (436421 Physical) and heal with Soul Cleave right after. You cannot remove the following Heartstop Poison, so tell a party member who can.
[회피] During Murder in a Row, hide behind the nearest barrel with the party, and leave with Vengeful Retreat or Infernal Strike before the shot barrel explodes 5 sec later.
Xathuux the Annihilator: [탱버] Use Demon Spikes and Fiery Brand for Legion Strike (533403 Physical, 80% healing reduction for 8 sec), and step sideways 2 sec before the cast so the frontal misses the party.
[탱버] Demonic Rage raises attack speed by 75% for 15 sec, so pop Metamorphosis (20 sec) to cover the whole window.
[탱버] Infernal Crush (Fire) follows right after Axe Toss, so use the remaining Fiery Brand charge as your second defensive, and use Infernal Strike when moving the boss to the axe.
[참고] Drop Darkness for the Chaos AoE of the second Demonic Rage.
Lithiel Cinderfury: [위치] Drag the boss to the farthest corner right at the pull. When the immortal Infernal gets close, open distance with Infernal Strike and Vengeful Retreat.
[차단] Kick Chaos Bolt with Disrupt. Cover Felfire Burst from Wild Imp groups with Sigil of Silence or Chaos Nova to keep Disrupt for Chaos Bolt.
[탱버] Furious Vilefiend's Shadow Bite is Shadow damage, so Fiery Brand handles it better than Demon Spikes.

Taz'Rah: [위치] Stand in the middle of the room before the boss appears, and when it lands, drag it to the outer wall away from the Ethereal Shades (Topicx).

[탱버] Void Blast (271551 Shadow + knockback) needs a defensive every time, so alternate the two Fiery Brand charges (48 sec each) and take the uncovered one with Metamorphosis. It is Shadow damage, so Demon Spikes does not reduce it.
[위치] When Void Blast knocks you back, Infernal Strike back over the pools.
[참고] Drop Darkness for Dark Bloom, the biggest party damage of this fight.
Atroxus: [탱버] Hulking Claw (242456 Nature + 10 sec Nature DoT that cannot be dispelled) is not reduced by Demon Spikes armor, so rotate the two Fiery Brand charges and Metamorphosis. When none is up, fill the gap with the Soul Barrier shield from Spirit Bomb, Fel Devastation healing and a potion.
[회피] If Toxic Creeper is about to catch you, open distance with Infernal Strike or Vengeful Retreat. Fight next to one of the two poison pads and move to the other once the floor gets dirty.
[해제] Vengeance Demon Hunters cannot remove Mind-Numbing Poison, so move the boss so nobody stands in Poison Pool and leave the dispel to party members.
Charonus: [탱버] Dark Waves (5 sec cast, 339438 Shadow) is not reduced by Demon Spikes, so take it with Fiery Brand plus Metamorphosis. Do not spend tank defensives on Cosmic Crash (Topicx).
[위치] Place the boss in front of 2 Singularities, not in the middle of all 3, and aim Dark Waves at the empty side away from the party and the Singularities.
[참고] Gravitic Orbs never target the tank, so drop Darkness while the party drags orbs into the Singularities.

The Golden Serpent: [탱버] Keep Demon Spikes up for every Tail Thrash (630386 Physical) cast. Method rates it low, so pop Fiery Brand only when your health runs short.
[제어] Park the boss in the corner behind the stairs, and hold the awakened Animated Gold inside your AoE with Sigil of Misery (2 min) or Chaos Nova (45 sec) before they reach the boss.

[광역 피해] Drop Darkness (5 min, 8 sec) for Serpentine Gust (Nature damage every sec for 5 sec + push), where Topicx uses a party defensive. If you get pushed away, Infernal Strike back in front of the boss.
[위치] When moving the boss, do not jump far with Infernal Strike. Drag it slowly to open space for new pools, and pull it toward the exit door once its health is low.
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Put Disrupt on the mummies' Wretched Discharge first; if missed, stop it with Sigil of Silence.
[위치] When awakened mummies scatter, grab threat with Torment and pull them next to the boss.
[위치] During the Entomb coffin search, Infernal Strike to the far coffin quickly.
The Council of Tribes: [탱버] Pop Demon Spikes and Fiery Brand for Aka'ali's Debilitating Backhand (727368 Physical + knockback), and raise your armor with Metamorphosis during the following Shattered Defenses (200% more Physical damage taken).
[탱버] If neither Metamorphosis nor Fiery Brand is available, kite with Vengeful Retreat and Infernal Strike until Shattered Defenses ends. If the knockback pushes you away, Infernal Strike back.
[탱버] Arc Lightning (135775 Nature) hits the tank right after Zanazal is engaged, so pop the remaining Fiery Brand charge. Demon Spikes armor does not reduce it.
[차단] Assign Disrupt to Zanazal's Poison Nova. Vengeance Demon Hunters cannot dispel poison.
Dazar, The First King: [탱버] In phase 1, only rotate Demon Spikes and save Metamorphosis and Fiery Brand (Topicx). Spending them elsewhere leaves you dry for the phase 2 overlap.

[탱버] After 80%, when Blade Combo follows T'zala's Savage Maul (Physical + bleed, 10% more Physical damage taken), stack Metamorphosis and Fiery Brand. Take overlaps without Metamorphosis with both Fiery Brand charges and an external defensive. Vengeance Demon Hunters cannot remove the bleed.
[차단] Assign Disrupt to Reban's Deathly Roar.
[위치] Taunt T'zala with Torment as soon as it appears at 80%.

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] Kick Frigid Shard (2.5 sec cast) yourself with Disrupt (15 sec) right after Hailburst ice lands, then drag the boss out of the ice. Do not leave it to DPS kicks (Topicx).
[탱버] Pop Demon Spikes for a Frigid Shard (775859 Physical) that lands while Disrupt is on cooldown, and add Fiery Brand if your health is low.
[위치] When Infused Whelps spawn, grab them with Sigil of Flame and Immolation Aura and stack them on the boss.
[해제] Clear the Cold Claws slow with Vengeful Retreat (25 sec) before 20 stacks (Wowhead). This is your self-dispel when many whelps outpace the healer's dispel.
[광역 피해] Drop Darkness (5 min, 8 sec) for Frost Overload party damage in the intermission with whelps and Ice Bulwark up together (Topicx: party defensive).
Kokia Blazehoof: [탱버] Searing Blows (4 Physical hits over 3 sec, each stacking an 8 sec Searing Wounds Fire DoT) needs a defensive every time, so pop Demon Spikes and alternate the two Fiery Brand charges (48 sec each). Fiery Brand also reduces the Fire DoT.
[탱버] Take a Searing Blows with no Fiery Brand charge with Metamorphosis (2 min), and recover from the remaining DoT with Soul Cleave and Fel Devastation.
[차단] Use Disrupt on Blaze Volley from the Blazebound Firestorm.
[위치] When a dying Firestorm casts Burnout (5 sec cast, 484912 Fire within 20 yd), drag the boss well out of the Scorched Earth area and Infernal Strike (15 sec) out first.
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [탱버] Take Erkhart's Stormslam (387930 Physical + 193965 Nature, stacking 100% more Nature damage taken) with only Demon Spikes. Save Fiery Brand and Metamorphosis for the Inferno Spit explosion and phase 2 (Topicx).
[탱버] If you are the Inferno Spit target, go out of the party to the edge toward the next wind direction and pop Fiery Brand as the 6 sec DoT ends and explodes.
[해제] Vengeance Demon Hunters cannot remove the Stormslam debuff (Magic), so ask the healer to dispel it before the next Stormslam.
[탱버] In phase 2, pop the Metamorphosis you saved and drop Darkness when party damage peaks.

Adderis & Aspix: [탱버] Pop Demon Spikes for Adderis's Overload (100% more attack speed for 8 sec, each melee hit adds 25% as Nature damage), and add Fiery Brand if the added Nature damage drains your health.
[위치] If Gale Force pushes you away, Infernal Strike (15 sec) straight back to the boss in the middle of the room (Topicx).
[광역 피해] Drop Darkness (5 min, 8 sec) for Thunder and Lightning, which the group splits in melee right after Gale Force.
Merektha: [탱버] Lightning Bite (533403 Physical + 7 sec Nature DoT) needs a defensive every time, so pop Demon Spikes and alternate the two Fiery Brand charges (48 sec each). Add Metamorphosis on high keys.
[위치] Check the egg positions on the floor before Hatch, and grab the Storm Serpent first with Torment or Throw Glaive when it appears (Topicx).
[차단] Kick Toxic Viper's Poison Spit with Disrupt. Vengeance Demon Hunters cannot dispel poison.
[광역 피해] Drop Darkness for Serpentstorm (party Nature damage + knockback), where Topicx uses a party defensive.
[참고] The snakes on the second boss cannot be silenced, so Sigil of Misery works better than Sigil of Silence here (Wowhead).
Galvazzt: [참고] The tank does not soak Lightning Spire beams. Galvanized raises Physical damage taken by 250%, so do not step in even with a defensive up (Topicx·Method).
[위치] Each time an Induction Field appears, move the boss to the next of the room's four corners in turn. Leave the field first with Vengeful Retreat or Infernal Strike and drag the boss.
Avatar of Sethraliss: [위치] When a Corrupted Guardian appears on the purple floor mark, Infernal Strike over and grab it with Torment (Topicx).
[탱버] Pop Demon Spikes for Tainted Strike (484912 Physical + 25 sec stacking Shadow DoT), and add Fiery Brand as the Shadow DoT stacks. Do not soak Corrupted Lifeforce while the Guardian is alive.
[차단] Kick Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock with Disrupt, and pull the Hexxer next to the Guardian with Torment.
[제어] Hold the Faithless Tormentors chasing the healer with Sigil of Misery or a Chaos Nova stun and kill them in one spot.

1265818.d: Metamorphosis has 5 sec increased duration and increases the damage of Fracture, Soul Cleave, and Spirit Bomb by 20%.

179057.m: 특성 · 격노 25 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
179057.d: 지옥 마력을 분출시켜 주위의 모든 적에게 (전투력의 27.4816%)의 혼돈 피해를 입히고 3초 동안 기절시킵니다. [혼돈의 파편: 혼돈의 회오리로 기절한 적 하나당 30%의 확률로 하급 영혼 파편을 생성합니다]

183752.m: 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간
183752.d: 적의 주문 시전을 방해하고 5초 동안 해당 계열의 주문을 시전하지 못하게 차단합니다. [방해의 격노: 차단에 성공하면 30의 격노가 생성됩니다]

185245.m: 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 8 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
185245.d: 적을 도발하여 자신을 공격하게 합니다. 6초 동안 대상을 향해 생성되는 위협 수준이 800%만큼 증가합니다.

187827.m: 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
187827.d: 15초 동안 악마 형상으로 탈태하여 현재 생명력이 40%만큼 증가하고 그만큼 생명력을 회복하며, 방어도 또한 200%만큼 증가합니다. [일리다리의 정점: 추가로 유연성이 0%만큼 증가합니다] [탈태: 변신한 동안 균열 사용 시 추가로 1개의 하급 영혼 파편을 생성합니다] [그리고 15의 격노를 추가로 생성합니다]

188501.d:
은신 및 투명 상태의 적과, 물리적 장애물 너머의 적과 보물을 볼 수 있습니다. 8초 동안 지속됩니다.
제어 불가 효과에 걸리면 시야가 해제됩니다.

189110.m: 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
189110.d: 대상 위치로 도약하여 6미터 내의 모든 적에게 (전투력의 62.6%)의 화염 피해를 입힙니다.

196718.d:
자신의 주위 8미터 반경 내에 어둠을 소환하여 아군 대상이 15%의 확률로 모든 피해를 회피할 수 있게 합니다. 8초 동안 지속됩니다.
공격대에 속해 있지 않을 때는 피해를 회피할 확률이 100%만큼 증가합니다.

198793.m: 특성 · 즉시 · 25 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
198793.d: 모든 감속 효과를 제거하고 도약하여 멀어집니다. 주위의 적은 (전투력의 16%)의 물리 피해를 입 [복수의 유대: 고 3초 동안 이동 속도가 70%만큼 감소합니다 / 습니다].

202137.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
202137.d:
대상 위치에 침묵의 인장을 생성하고 2초 후 활성화시킵니다.
인장의 영향을 받는 모든 적을 2초 동안 침묵시킵니다.

203720.m: 즉시 · 20 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
203720.d: 지옥의 힘이 쇄도하여 12초 동안 방어도가 (75 * 민첩성 / 100)만큼 [악마 쐐기: 무기 막기 확률이 8%만큼 증가합니다 /  증가합니다].

203981.d: 주위의 영혼 파편을 흡수하여 생명력을 회복합니다.

204021.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
204021.d: 적에게 악마의 상징으로 낙인을 찍습니다. 받는 피해가 40%만큼 감소하고 적에게 즉시 (전투력의 416%)의 화염 피해를 입힙니다. [불타는 낙인: 추가로 12초에 걸쳐 [(전투력의 32.2%) * 12]의 화염 피해를 입힙니다]

204157.m: 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 9 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
204157.d: 대상에게 악마의 글레이브를 투척하여 (전투력의 21.151%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 이후 글레이브는 10미터 내의 적에게 [튀어오르는 글레이브: 추가로 1회까지 / 추가로 1회까지] 튕깁니다. 위협 수준이 크게 증가합니다.

204596.m: 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
204596.d:
대상 위치에 불꽃의 인장을 생성하고 2초 후 활성화시킵니다.
인장의 영향을 받는 모든 적에게 (전투력의 80%)의 화염 피해를 입히고, 추가로 8초에 걸쳐 총 (전투력의 200%)의 화염 피해를 입힙니다.
25의 격노를 생성합니다.

207684.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
207684.d:
대상 위치에 불행의 인장을 생성하고 2초 후 활성화시킵니다.
인장의 영향을 받는 모든 적은 공포에 질려 제자리에서 떨게 되며, 15초 동안 방향 감각을 상실합니다.

209258.d:
죽음에 이르는 피해를 입으면 탈태 형상으로 변신합니다.
이 효과는 8분에 한 번씩만 발동합니다.

212084.m: 특성 · 격노 50 · 20 야드 사정거리 · 집중 (2 초 주문 시전 시간) · 40 초 재사용 대기시간
212084.d: 내면의 지옥을 방출하여, 2초에 걸쳐 전방 직선 상의 적에게 [(전투력의 41.1%) * (10)]의 화염 피해를 입힙니다. [지옥 황폐: 또한 적에게 피해를 입히면 자신의 생명력을 [(전투력의 562.5%) * 10]만큼 회복합니다]

217832.m: 특성 · 20 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
217832.d: 1분 동안 악마, 야수, 인간형 대상을 감금하여 행동 불가 상태로 만듭니다. 대상이 피해를 입으면 효과가 해제될 수 있습니다. 대상은 하나로 제한됩니다.

228477.d:
전방에 있는 적과 다른 모든 적을 잔혹하게 공격하여 (전투력의 208%)의 물리 피해를 입히고 자신의 생명력을 (전투력의 300%)만큼 회복시킵니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.
최대 2개의 영혼 파편을 소모하며, 소모한 파편 하나당 공격력이 20%만큼 증가합니다.

232893.m: 특성 · 15 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 12 초 재사용 대기시간
232893.d:
대상에게 돌진하여 (전투력의 122.94%)%의 화염 피해를 입힙니다.
[균열: 15의 격노를 생성합니다.] [악마의 수호: 15의 격노를 생성합니다.]15의 격노를 생성합니다.

247454.m: 특성 · 격노 40 · 즉시 · 25 초 재사용 대기시간
247454.d: 영혼 파편을 최대 5개까지 흡수한 후 폭발을 일으켜 주위의 적에게 (전투력의 200%)의 화염 피해를 입힙니다. 흡수한 파편 하나당 공격력이 20 / 영혼분쇄: 30 / 고삐 풀린 분노: 25%만큼 증가합니다. 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

258920.m: 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
258920.d:
자신의 몸을 불길로 뒤덮어 열기를 내뿜어 1초마다 [(전투력의 12.466%) * 6]의 화염 피해를 입힙니다. 6초 동안 지속됩니다.
[
20의 격노를 생성합니다.]
6초에 걸쳐 20의 격노를 생성합니다.
(500밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

263642.m: 특성 · 근접 사정거리 · 즉시 · 5.5 초 재사용 대기시간 · 2회 사용 가능
263642.d:
대상을 빠르게 베어 [(전투력의 103.5%)% + (전투력의 207%)%]의 물리 피해를 입히고, 하급 영혼 파편 2개를 떼어냅니다.
25의 격노를 생성합니다.

278326.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 10 초 재사용 대기시간
278326.d: 대상의 이로운 마법 효과 1개를 흡수하여 제거합니다. [삼켜진 분노: 추가로 20의 격노를 생성합니다]

389958.d:
불꽃의 인장, 영혼 베어내기, 영혼 폭탄에 적중당한 적은 8초 동안 약화에 걸립니다.
약화에 걸린 대상에게는 입힌 모든 피해의 10%만큼 생명력을 회복합니다.

390163.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
390163.d:
지정한 위치에 2초 후에 발동하는 악마의 인장을 놓습니다.
인장은 폭발을 일으켜 적에게 (전투력의 692%)의 혼돈 피해를 입히고 영향을 받은 적의 영혼을 조각내 최대 3개의 영혼 파편을 생성합니다. 5명을 넘는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

442290.d:
영혼 파편 20개를 흡수하거나 원한의 인장을 시전하면 다음 글레이브 투척이 파괴자의 글레이브로 전환됩니다.
파괴자의 글레이브: 
흡수한 영혼의 정수로 강화된 전투검을 대상에게 던져 (전투력의 481%)의 물리 피해를 입히고 2명의 추가 적에게 튕겨 피해를 입힙니다.
이후 철저하게 연마한 전투검술을 구사하여 다음 균열 및 영혼 베어내기를 강화합니다.
처음으로 시전하는 강화된 능력은 15%의 추가 피해를 입히며, 두 번째 능력은 30%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

442294.d:
흡수한 영혼의 정수로 강화된 전투검을 대상에게 던져 (전투력의 481%)의 물리 피해를 입히고 2명의 추가 적에게 튕겨 피해를 입힙니다.
이후 철저하게 연마한 전투검술을 구사하여 다음 균열 및 영혼 베어내기를 강화합니다.
처음으로 시전하는 강화된 능력은 15%의 추가 피해를 입히며, 두 번째 능력은 30%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다.

442679.d:
파괴자의 글레이브로 강화되면 균열 사용 시 파괴자의 징표를 부여해 20초 동안 대상이 받는 피해를 8%만큼 증가시킵니다. 최대 2번까지 중첩됩니다.
영혼 베어내기를 사용한 후에 파괴자의 징표 1중첩을 추가로 부여합니다.

1253304.d:
균열 사용 시 35%의 확률로 공허내림 1중첩이 부여됩니다.
공허내림이 3번 중첩되면 영혼 베어내기가 중첩 하나를 소모해 공허와 연결되어 대상의 위치로 유성을 불러 내립니다. 유성은 8미터 내의 모든 적에게 (전투력의 540%)의 암흑불길 피해를 입힙니다. 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

1253377.d:
지옥 황폐의 공격력이 25%만큼 증가합니다.
지옥 황폐 시전 시 지속시간에 걸쳐 영혼 파편 3개를 생성합니다.

1256353.d: 세 번째로 불러 내리는 공허내림 유성은 훨씬 커져 반경이 50%만큼 증가하고 50%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다. 또한 탈태의 남은 재사용 대기시간이 10초만큼 감소합니다.

1265924.d: 영혼 폭탄 사용 시 10초 동안 (총 생명력 * 8 / 100)의 피해를 흡수하는 보호막을 얻습니다. 소모한 영혼 파편 하나당 피해 흡수량이 (총 생명력 * 2 / 100)만큼 증가합니다.

389732.d: 불타는 낙인의 재사용 대기시간이 12초 감소하고 추가로 1회 충전됩니다.

1265818.d: 탈태의 지속시간이 5초만큼 연장되고 균열, 영혼 베어내기, 영혼 폭탄의 공격력이 20%만큼 증가합니다.

1: [탱버] Pop Demon Spikes for Virid Grovekeeper's Earthrupture Strike (533403 Physical) and put Fiery Brand on the Virid Grovekeeper. Down in Flames gives Fiery Brand 2 charges (48 sec each), so keep the other charge for Spouting Floret.

[탱버] This is the biggest pull and the Bloodlust pull, so line up Metamorphosis (2 min, 20 sec with Vengeful Beast) and Darkness (5 min) with Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret. Spouting Floret is Holy damage, so Demon Spikes armor does not reduce it.
[제어] When Radiant Spellsower runs off with Call The Grove, stun it with Chaos Nova (45 sec), and clear the Spore Spines slow stacked by the 13 Lashers with Vengeful Retreat (25 sec) (Wowhead).
2: [탱버] Use the remaining Fiery Brand charge on Sporeblight Belcher for the Holy damage of Spouting Floret. Metamorphosis was spent on pull 1, so save it and refill health with Fel Devastation (40 sec) healing.
[차단] Group the 2 Radiant Spellsowers and cover Light Bolt Volley on both with Sigil of Silence (1.5 min, activates 1 sec faster with Quickened Sigils); kick the rest with Disrupt (15 sec).
3: [탱버] Use Demon Spikes and Fiery Brand for Earthrupture Strike, and add Metamorphosis if its 2 min cooldown from pull 1 is back.
[제어] If Radiant Spellsower runs toward the 12 Lashers, stun it with Chaos Nova; if Chaos Nova is on cooldown, hold it with Sigil of Misery (2 min).
[해제] With this many Lashers, Spore Spines stacks quickly; clear the slow with Vengeful Retreat (Wowhead).
5: [탱버] Spend one Fiery Brand charge on Spouting Floret from the Sporeblight Belcher you pull first, then use Demon Spikes and the other Fiery Brand charge on Earthrupture Strike from the Virid Grovekeeper pulled 5-6 sec later.
[제어] Break Thorny Saptor's Thornclaw Leap follow-up with the Chaos Nova stun.
[차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Disrupt.
7: [탱버] Two Luminous Thornmaws stack Grievous Gash (387930 Physical + stacking bleed), so keep Demon Spikes up without gaps and split the two Fiery Brand charges, one per Luminous Thornmaw.
[탱버] The bleed only falls off at full health, so top yourself off with the instant 40% health from Metamorphosis and Fel Devastation healing.
[해제] Remove Spineshield Beetle's Spiny Shield with Consume Magic (10 sec) (Wowhead).
8: [탱버] Put Fiery Brand on Sporeblight Belcher for Spouting Floret. Metamorphosis was used on pull 7, so survive this pull on Fiery Brand and the Soul Barrier shield from Spirit Bomb.
[제어] Once both Thorny Saptors are grouped, stop Thornclaw Leap on both with Chaos Nova.
[해제] Strip Spiny Shield from the 5 Spineshield Beetles one by one with Consume Magic (Wowhead).
10: [탱버] Keep Demon Spikes up for Potatoad Matriarch's Tongue Toss (290947 Physical), and when it flings you over, come straight back with Infernal Strike (15 sec). Save Metamorphosis for pull 11.
[해제] Clear stacked Spore Spines slows from the Lashers with Vengeful Retreat (Wowhead).
11: [탱버] Luminous Thornmaw's Grievous Gash overlaps with Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret, so put Fiery Brand on the Luminous Thornmaw and use Metamorphosis.
[차단] Group the 3 Lightfeather Petalwings and cover Disorienting Screech with Sigil of Silence; kick any missed cast with Disrupt.
12: [차단] Split Light Bolt Volley from the 2 Radiant Spellsowers between Disrupt and Chaos Nova. If Sigil of Silence from pull 11 is back after 1.5 min, cover both with it.
[탱버] Put Fiery Brand on Sporeblight Belcher for Spouting Floret, and add Darkness if it is back 5 min after pull 1.
[참고] Lightgorged Lashers under Lightbloom Pollination are immune to crowd control, so save Chaos Nova and Sigil of Misery for Radiant Spellsower.

1: [탱버] The 7 Ravenous Descendants stack attack speed, so keep Demon Spikes (20 sec) up without gaps; this is the Bloodlust opener, so pop Metamorphosis (2 min, 20 sec with Vengeful Beast) together with one Fiery Brand charge.

[차단] Kick one of the 2 Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss with Disrupt (15 sec). Piercing Hiss is Physical damage that ignores armor, so Demon Spikes does not reduce it; if one goes through, take it with the other Fiery Brand charge.
[제어] If Descendant stacks get painful, stop their swings with the 3 sec Chaos Nova (45 sec) stun, and clear the Paralyzing Shots slow from Twinfang Harrower with Vengeful Retreat (25 sec).
2: [탱버] Pop Demon Spikes for Ritual Chieftain's Dismember (581895 Physical, 3 sec cast) and put Fiery Brand on the Chieftain. Metamorphosis was spent on pull 1, so refill health with Fel Devastation (40 sec) healing.
[광역 피해] Blood Sacrifice party Physical damage is the most painful part of this section, so drop Darkness (5 min, 8 sec) in front of the Chieftain.
3: [위치] Break line of sight behind the pillar so the 3 Primal Serpents walk down, then drop Sigil of Silence (1.5 min) where they stack to cover Piercing Hiss on all of them. Kick the rest with Disrupt.

4: [탱버] Use Demon Spikes and Fiery Brand for Dismember, and save Metamorphosis for pull 5.
[차단] Kick one of the 2 Primal Serpents with Disrupt, and stop the other's cast with the Chaos Nova stun.
5: [탱버] Two Twinfang Harrowers plus a Ritual Chieftain make this the heaviest pull, so use Metamorphosis, back 2 min after pull 1, and stack Fiery Brand on Dismember.
[위치] Point Twinfang Harrower's Toxic Breath (Nature, 3 sec cast) frontal away from the party, and clear stacked Paralyzing Shots slows with Vengeful Retreat.
7: [탱버] Rattling Writhe's Corrosive Fangs (242456 Nature, 3 sec cast) is not reduced by Demon Spikes armor, so take it with Fiery Brand. Damage taken stays 20% higher for 20 sec afterwards, so chain the Soul Barrier shield from Spirit Bomb.
[차단] Kick High Evolutionist's Envenom with Disrupt so it does not land right before Rattle, and break the Evolve channel with the Chaos Nova stun.
[제어] The 3 Bloodletters leave blood pools with every melee swing, so hold them for 15 sec with Sigil of Misery (2 min).
8: [탱버] Use the remaining Fiery Brand charge on Corrosive Fangs.

9: [차단] Once the far-left High Evolutionist pulled in by a ranged player is stacked, cover its Mass Envenom with Sigil of Silence, and kick the near one with Disrupt.
[탱버] Put Fiery Brand up for Corrosive Fangs, and add Metamorphosis if 2 min have passed since pull 5.
11: [차단] Group the 4 High Evolutionists and cover Mass Envenom on all of them with Sigil of Silence; Disrupt takes one of them.
[제어] If Evolve channels overlap, stun them all at once with Chaos Nova to deny the shield and crowd control immunity.
12: [탱버] Point Ascendant Serpent's Noxious Spray (Nature, 5 sec) away from the party and take it under Fiery Brand. Add Metamorphosis if your health drops during the pushback.
[위치] If the pinged Infest spot is far or Noxious Spray pushed you away, Infernal Strike (15 sec) straight back and gather the party.
13: [차단] Kick every Mass Envenom from Ula'tek's Chosen with Disrupt, and cover it with Sigil of Silence when Disrupt is on cooldown.
[제어] Stun Blade of the Altar with Chaos Nova during the 9 sec Toxic Surge so it cannot teleport.
[참고] When the Living Venoms are all low together, aim the Fel Devastation frontal only at Ula'tek's Chosen so their Venom Burst does not go off at once.
14: [차단] Kick Mass Envenom with Disrupt, and back it up with Sigil of Silence if it is back 1.5 min after pull 13.
[제어] During Toxic Surge, hold Blade of the Altar with Sigil of Misery to stop its teleport attacks.
15: [차단] Split Piercing Hiss from the 2 Primal Serpents between Disrupt and Sigil of Silence. It ignores armor, so take a missed cast with Fiery Brand.
[위치] Point Twinfang Harrower's Toxic Breath away from the party, and clear the Paralyzing Shots slow with Vengeful Retreat.
16: [탱버] The two Ritual Chieftains cast Dismember separately, so split the two Fiery Brand charges one per Chieftain and use Metamorphosis.
[광역 피해] Blood Sacrifice comes back to back and overlaps with Toxic Surge, so drop Darkness here if it is back.
[차단] Kick every Mass Envenom from Ula'tek's Chosen with Disrupt.

1: [탱버] This is the Bloodlust pull with Bribed Captain and Bribed Guard together, so pop Metamorphosis (2 min, 20 sec with Vengeful Beast) and stack Demon Spikes and Fiery Brand for the Guard's Shield Bash (Physical, 20% more Physical damage taken for 20 sec).
[해제] Remove Fel Crazed from Felonious Mages with Consume Magic (10 sec) (Wowhead).
[참고] Vengeance Demon Hunters cannot remove Street Sneak's Heartstop Poison, so call for the poison dispeller before stacks build.
2: [위치] Line of sight the inner-room casters from outside the door. If a Felonious Mage does not walk, interrupt it with Disrupt (15 sec) so it comes to you.
[차단] Stop Seduction from the 2 Seductive Sayaads with Disrupt on one and the Chaos Nova (45 sec) stun or Sigil of Silence (1.5 min) on the other.
3: [탱버] Use Demon Spikes and Fiery Brand (2 charges, 48 sec each) for Bribed Guard's Shield Bash.
[해제] Remove Fel Crazed from Felonious Mages with Consume Magic (Wowhead).
4: [제어] While the 4 Street Sneaks coat their weapons with Heartstop Poison for 8 sec, hold them with Chaos Nova or Sigil of Misery (2 min) to slow the poison stacks.
[탱버] Your maximum health is reduced, so pop Fiery Brand and refill with Metamorphosis if 2 min have passed since pull 1.
5: [탱버] Massive Felwyrm's Corroding Spittle is Fire damage that Demon Spikes armor does not reduce, so take it with Fiery Brand. Grab the Summon Wyrms hatchlings with Sigil of Flame and Immolation Aura.

[회피] When Massive Felwyrm dies and casts Massive Fel Detonation (5 sec cast, 10 yd), get out with Vengeful Retreat (25 sec) or Infernal Strike (15 sec). Remove Fel Crazed from Felonious Mages with Consume Magic (Wowhead).
8: [차단] Spend Disrupt first on Fel Rage (3.5 sec cast) from the 2 Wrathguard Flayers, and cover Fel Invoker's Health Funnel with Sigil of Silence.
[탱버] Trained Felhunter's Shadow Bite is Shadow damage that Demon Spikes does not reduce, so take it with Fiery Brand.
[회피] Leave Shivan Punisher's Whirlwind (4 sec cast, 12 yd 290947 Physical) with Vengeful Retreat and come back.
9: [차단] Split Fel Rage from the 2 Wrathguard Flayers between Disrupt and Sigil of Silence. If it goes through they become immune to crowd control, so use Chaos Nova before the cast.
[참고] Vengeance Demon Hunters cannot remove Corrupted Warlock's Curse of Doom, so gather around the target to split the damage, and pop Fiery Brand if you are the Drain Life target.
10: [차단] Kick the first Health Funnel from the 2 Fel Invokers with Disrupt and Sigil of Silence.
[회피] Avoid Shivan Punisher's Whirlwind with Vengeful Retreat or Infernal Strike, and pop Fiery Brand during the Demonic Frenzy phase below 50%.
11: [광역 피해] Felmaster Lucsei's Blade Dance is party Fire damage, so drop Darkness (5 min, 8 sec) for the first Blade Dance and hold yourself up with Metamorphosis.
[탱버] Put Fiery Brand up for Shadow Bite Shadow damage from the 2 Trained Felhunters. Point the Eye Beam frontal away from the party.
13: [차단] Drag the pack onto the 6 Unleashed Imps and cover Felfire Burst at once with Sigil of Silence; save Disrupt for Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage.
[탱버] Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam (Fire) and Defiled Detonation (Shadow) overlap, so pop Fiery Brand and add Metamorphosis if 2 min have passed since pull 11.
14: [차단] Kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage with Disrupt, and group Unleashed Imps and Fel Invoker to cover them with Sigil of Silence.
[탱버] Put Fiery Brand up for Shadow Bite from the 2 Trained Felhunters.
15: [위치] Pull Corrupted Warlock back and kill it first. If Shivan Punisher comes along, lock it in Imprison (45 sec) for 1 min and kill the Warlock first.
[탱버] Shadow Bite from 3 Trained Felhunters stacks up, so pop Fiery Brand and Metamorphosis, and use the remaining Fiery Brand charge if you are the Drain Life target.
16: [광역 피해] For Defiled Golem's Defiled Slam, drop Darkness if it is back 5 min after pull 11. Avoid Fel Beam by walking backward toward the last boss.
[차단] Kick Health Funnel from the 2 Fel Invokers with Disrupt and Sigil of Silence, and put Fiery Brand up for Trained Felhunter's Shadow Bite.

1: [탱버] Vengeance Demon Hunters cannot remove the Mother's Wrath enrage from the 2 Territorial Matriarchs, so on this Bloodlust opener pop Metamorphosis (2 min, 20 sec with Vengeful Beast) and split the two Fiery Brand charges (48 sec each) one per Matriarch.
[광역 피해] Drop Darkness (5 min, 8 sec) when Spirit of Hunger's Feast of Misery (Shadow, 5 sec channel) overlaps with the Insatiable Hunger curse.
[참고] Grab the Keen-Eyed Striker that flies in to steal the berry bush with Torment (8 sec) or Throw Glaive.
2: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Earth Bolt and Healing Breeze with Disrupt (15 sec), and remove a missed Healing Breeze with Consume Magic (10 sec) (Wowhead).
[탱버] When Matriarch enrage stacks build, stack Fiery Brand on top of Demon Spikes.
4: [탱버] Razor Dive bleeds from 3 Keen-Eyed Strikers stack on top of a Matriarch, so pop Fiery Brand and add Metamorphosis if 2 min have passed since pull 1.
[참고] Grab Strikers flying in with Scavenge using Torment and pull them into the pack.

7: [탱버] With 2 Territorial Matriarchs, split the two Fiery Brand charges one per Matriarch. Topicx calls this a cooldown pull, so add Darkness if it is back 5 min after pull 1.
[차단] Group the 2 Earthwhisper Tenders and cover both with Sigil of Silence (1.5 min); kick the rest with Disrupt. Remove a missed Healing Breeze with Consume Magic (Wowhead).
8: [탱버] Frostfang's Frostbite is Frost damage that Demon Spikes armor does not reduce, and Physical damage from 2 Matriarchs stacks on top. Use Metamorphosis on this pull and add the recovered Fiery Brand charge.
[제어] When the 5 Frostfangs gain 60% attack speed from Bloodrush, hold them for 15 sec with Sigil of Misery (2 min).
9: [차단] Split Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast) from the 2 Frigid Maulers between Disrupt and Sigil of Silence. If it lands, clear the movement slow with Vengeful Retreat (25 sec) (Wowhead).
[탱버] Pop Fiery Brand, which reduces Frost damage, during Frostfang's Bloodrush.
10: [차단] Stop Frigid Roar on one Frigid Mauler with Disrupt and on the other with the Chaos Nova (45 sec) stun.
[탱버] Put Fiery Brand up for Frostbite from the 3 Frostfangs. Clear a missed Frigid Roar slow with Vengeful Retreat (Wowhead).
11: [회피] Leave the range of Avatar of Determination's Pulverize (4 sec cast, 12 yd 387930 Physical plus stun) with Vengeful Retreat or Infernal Strike (15 sec), and come back when the cast ends.
[탱버] Put Fiery Brand up for Frostfang's Frostbite, and add Metamorphosis if 2 min have passed since pull 8.
13: [탱버] Primal Echo from the 2 Grizzled Warbringers is Physical damage that ignores armor, so Demon Spikes does not reduce it; take the first Echo with Fiery Brand and the next with Metamorphosis.
[차단] Split Arc Lightning (4 sec cast) from the 2 Stormbound Mystics between Disrupt and Sigil of Silence.
14: [차단] Kick Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning with Disrupt.
[탱버] You cannot remove the Bestial Wrath enrage from Bonded Beasttamer and Loyal Saberfang, so pop Fiery Brand for its 10 sec.
15: [탱버] The 4 Grizzled Warbringers alternate Primal Echo, so rotate the two Fiery Brand charges and Metamorphosis one per Echo, and refill health with Fel Devastation before the next Echo.
[광역 피해] Armor-ignoring Primal Echo stacks on the whole party, so drop Darkness here if it is back.
[차단] Split Arc Lightning from the 2 Stormbound Mystics between Disrupt and Sigil of Silence.
16: [차단] Kick Loa Speaker Nanea's Lightning Bolt with Disrupt, and if you are targeted by Earthquake, Infernal Strike out so the zone lands away from the party.
[참고] If you use Bloodlust here on high keys, line up Metamorphosis and Darkness with it.

1: [차단] The tank takes the first kick on Voidtouched Magi's Shadowbolt Volley, so stop it with Disrupt (15 sec, 10 yd with Improved Disrupt). Line of sight the Magi around the corner into the room.
[탱버] This is the Bloodlust opener, so pop Metamorphosis (2 min, 20 sec with Vengeful Beast), and add Fiery Brand (2 charges, 48 sec each) when Savage Leap bleeds from Feral Saberon stack up.
[위치] If you are targeted by Null Eruption (Shadow, 10 yd), step out of the party and pop Fiery Brand. It is Shadow damage, so Demon Spikes does not reduce it.
2: [탱버] For Raj'kess the Spellstorm's long Thundering Storm party AoE, pop Fiery Brand and hold on with Fel Devastation (40 sec) healing.
[참고] When the 3 Orb of Disruption orbs spawn, throw Throw Glaive at them right away and Infernal Strike (15 sec) over to kill them with the group.
3: [광역 피해] Drop Darkness (5 min, 8 sec) for Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (10 sec party Nature damage) and stack Fiery Brand on it.
[탱버] Brutok's Head Bash comes with a knockback right after its stun ends, so pop Demon Spikes and Infernal Strike back if you get knocked away. Stand so Smashing Charge goes toward the nearest wall.
[해제] Remove Melt Armor from Sycophantic Tarasek with Consume Magic (10 sec), and clear the Violent Sand slow from Angry Krolusk with Vengeful Retreat (25 sec) (Wowhead).
5: [차단] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 60 yd fear) is the most important kick in this area, so keep Disrupt for it and cover Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt with Sigil of Silence (1.5 min).

[탱버] Pop Demon Spikes for Savage Shredclaw's Shred Defense (Physical, 20% more damage taken for 10 sec), and if you are the Void Beam (Shadow) target of Watchful Harrower, step out of the party and pop Fiery Brand.
6: [탱버] Brutal Overseer's Brutal Slams party Physical damage is dangerous when it overlaps the Watchful Harrower Sky Strike soak, so use Metamorphosis, back 2 min after pull 1, at that moment.
[회피] If you are the Macestorm target, keep moving with Vengeful Retreat or Infernal Strike, and kick Dominated Brawler's Demoralizing Shout with Disrupt.
8: [탱버] Devouring Brutalizer always follows Dreadbellow with Brutalize (678877 Physical every 1.5 sec for 6 sec), so pop Demon Spikes, Fiery Brand and Metamorphosis together on the Dreadbellow cast. If the knockback pushes you away, Infernal Strike back and keep the boss in front of you.
[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Disrupt, and cover Mending Void from the 2 Voidminders with Sigil of Silence.
[해제] Remove Melt Armor from the 3 Sycophantic Tarasek one by one with Consume Magic (Wowhead).
9: [탱버] Stack Demon Spikes and both Fiery Brand charges for Brutalize. Metamorphosis was used on pull 8, so fill the gap with the Soul Barrier shield and Fel Devastation healing.
[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Disrupt, and group Enthralled Shaman and the Voidminders to cover them with Sigil of Silence.
10: [탱버] For Brutalize, use Metamorphosis, back 2 min after pull 8, and Fiery Brand, then chain-pull Watchful Harrower after the Brutalizer dies.
[광역 피해] If the Dreadbellow Shadow DoT overlaps the Sky Strike soak, drop Darkness, back 5 min after pull 3. Cover Mending Void from the 2 Voidminders with Sigil of Silence.

1: [탱버] This is the first Bloodlust pull, so pop Metamorphosis (2 min, 20 sec with Vengeful Beast) and keep Demon Spikes rolling without gaps for the Heavy Slams (Physical) of the 2 Animated Guardians.

[차단] Stop Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (Shadow damage + curse) with Disrupt (15 sec). If Shadowfrost Bolt slows you, clear it with Vengeful Retreat (25 sec) (Wowhead).
4: [탱버] When the King A'akul pack wakes up, Mortal Bleed and Sudden Rupture from Bloodsworn Assassin overlap and make Blood Drain (164870 Physical) hit harder, so spend Metamorphosis, back 2 min after pull 1, and Fiery Brand on this pack. Vengeance Demon Hunters cannot remove bleeds.

5: [광역 피해] Drop Darkness for Purification Construct's Purifying Flame (174568 party Fire). If 5 min have not passed since The Golden Serpent, protect your own health with Fiery Brand.
[해제] If Putrid Seekers from Embalming Fluid slows you (20%, 12 sec), clear it with Vengeful Retreat and back out of the pool.
6: [차단] Vengeance Demon Hunters cannot dispel Wretched Discharge (4 sec cast, disease) from the 2 Half-Finished Mummies, so group them and cover both with Sigil of Silence, then kick the next cast with Disrupt.
7: [차단] Sigil of Silence used on pull 6 is not back yet, so kick one Half-Finished Mummy with Disrupt and stop the other cast with Chaos Nova or Sigil of Misery (2 min).
9: [차단] The 2 Phantom Hex Priests cast nonstop, so group them and cover both with Sigil of Silence, and kick Hex (3.5 sec cast) with Disrupt.
[탱버] When Bloodthirsty Axe bleeds (Physical) from the 2 Royal Berserkers stack up, add Fiery Brand on top of Demon Spikes. Save Metamorphosis for the Ghostly Brute on the next pull.
10: [탱버] For Ghostly Brute's Soul Crush (727368 Physical, 30% more Physical damage taken for 15 sec), pop Demon Spikes and Fiery Brand, and add Metamorphosis with the third Bloodlust.
[회피] Leave Seismic Upheaval (5 sec cast, 387930 Physical around it + knock-up) with Vengeful Retreat or Infernal Strike (15 sec), then Infernal Strike back. Kick the Phantom Hex Priest with Disrupt.
12: [탱버] Infernal Strike in first so the tank takes Shadow of Zul's Shadow Barrage (Shadow + 4 sec DoT), and pop Fiery Brand because Demon Spikes does not reduce it.
[위치] Stand in the near Pool of Darkness, and if you are the Dark Revelation target (473120 Shadow within 20 yd after 5 sec), Vengeful Retreat away from the party.

1: [탱버] Tectonic Strike (25% more damage taken for 8 sec, stacking) from the 4 Deepstone Earthshapers piles up right after the pull, so open with Metamorphosis (2 min, 20 sec with Vengeful Beast) and Demon Spikes, and pop Fiery Brand (2 charges, 48 sec each) for Primal Juggernaut's Crushing Smash (533403 Physical + 145474 Nature).

2: [탱버] Pop the Fiery Brand charge saved from pull 1 for Primal Juggernaut's Crushing Smash and keep Demon Spikes up.
[해제] Clear the Cold Claws slow from Infused Whelps hatched in the water with Vengeful Retreat before 20 stacks (Wowhead). Kick the Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Disrupt.
3: [탱버] Defier Draghar's Steel Barrage (242456 Physical every 0.5 sec for 3 sec) needs a defensive every time, so pop Demon Spikes, alternate the two Fiery Brand charges, and take the uncovered one with Metamorphosis if it is back (2 min after pull 1).
[제어] Stun the 2 Deepstone Earthshapers with Chaos Nova so Tectonic Strike stacks do not overlap Steel Barrage, and kick the Chillweaver's Ice Shield with Disrupt.
5: [탱버] Blazebound Destroyer's Fiery Blast (4 sec cast, 358835 Fire) only targets the tank and is not reduced by Demon Spikes, so pop Fiery Brand.

[제어] Flaming Barrage (10 sec channel, cannot be interrupted) from the 2 Ashseer Flamelashers targets the tank, so stop it with a Chaos Nova stun. Remove Blaze of Glory, which they cast on death, with Consume Magic (10 sec) (Wowhead).
[차단] Spend Disrupt on Primalist Cinderweaver's Cinderbolt first, and Infernal Strike (15 sec) out when the dying Destroyer casts Burnout (20 yd).
6: [탱버] Pop Demon Spikes and Fiery Brand for Flamegullet's Fire Maw (581895 Physical + Fire DoT), and add Metamorphosis if it overlaps Blazebound Destroyer's Fiery Blast. Pull Flamegullet with Throw Glaive once it walks close.
[광역 피해] When Flamegullet ramps party Fire damage with Molten Blood below 50%, drop Darkness (5 min, 8 sec), back 5 min after the Melidrussa intermission.
[제어] Stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Sigil of Misery (2 min) or Chaos Nova, and remove Blaze of Glory with Consume Magic (Wowhead).
7: [탱버] Kick Blazebound Destroyer's Fiery Blast if Disrupt is free, otherwise take it with Fiery Brand.
[제어] Stun both Ashseer Flamelashers with Chaos Nova to stop Flaming Barrage, and remove Blaze of Glory with Consume Magic (Wowhead).
8: [탱버] Pop Fiery Brand for Fiery Blast, and use Metamorphosis, back 2 min after pull 6, when Flaming Barrage from the 2 Flamelashers overlaps.
[제어] If Chaos Nova used on pull 7 is not back, stop the Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Sigil of Misery, and cover Cinderbolt from the 2 Cinderweavers with Sigil of Silence.
10: [탱버] Tempest Channeler's Thunder Blast (4 sec cast, 387930 Nature) only targets the tank, so kick it if Disrupt is free, otherwise take it with Fiery Brand. Keep Demon Spikes up against the melee of the 6 Storm Warriors and pop Metamorphosis, back 2 min after pull 8.
[제어] Stop Ashseer Flamelasher's Flaming Barrage with Chaos Nova, and remove Blaze of Glory with Consume Magic (Wowhead).
11: [탱버] This stretch is chain-pulled without stopping and Metamorphosis is down, so kick Tempest Channeler's Thunder Blast with Disrupt or take it with the remaining Fiery Brand charge.
12: [광역 피해] If High Channeler Ryvati's Tempest Stormshield expires unbroken, it stuns everyone within 60 yd for 4 sec, so focus damage on the shield, and pop Fiery Brand if you are the Lightning Torrent target (7 sec Nature channel). Save Darkness for phase 2 of Kyrakka & Erkhart right after.
[해제] Remove Stormcloud Barrier (shield worth 85% of max health) from the Primal Thunderclouds Ryvati summons with Consume Magic (Wowhead).

1: [탱버] Pop Demon Spikes and Fiery Brand (2 charges, 48 sec each) for Sandfury Stonefist's Sunder Slam (387930 Physical, stacking 50% more Physical damage taken for 10 sec), and since this first pull builds stacks, use Metamorphosis (2 min, 20 sec with Vengeful Beast) with it.

[차단] Line of sight the 3 Storm Adepts at the tunnel's end corner to group them, cover them together with Sigil of Silence (1.5 min), and kick the Lightning Bolt that overlaps Ground Pound (4 sec cast, party Physical + knockback) with Disrupt (15 sec).
[제어] Stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage (9 sec channel) with a Chaos Nova (45 sec) stun. The Stonefist is CC immune.
2: [위치] Infernal Strike (15 sec) onto the 2 stealthed Shrouded Fangs under the stairs so the tank opens the fight. Vengeance Demon Hunters cannot remove the Poisoned Cheap Shot poison.
[탱버] Pop the Fiery Brand charge saved from pull 1 for the Stonefist's Sunder Slam and keep Demon Spikes up.
4: [제어] If Swarming Krolusks summoned by Sand-Sworn Rider run at distant DPS, pull them with Torment (8 sec) or hold them with Sigil of Misery (2 min).
[차단] Kick Storm Adept's Lightning Bolt with Disrupt and stop Sandswept Hunter's Arrow Barrage with Chaos Nova.
5: [탱버] Pop Demon Spikes and Fiery Brand for Krolusk Matriarch's Head Butt (3 sec cast, 727368 Physical), and spend Metamorphosis, back 2 min after pull 1, on this big pull where Barbed Krolusk Serrated Charge bleeds overlap with Krolusk adds.
[차단] Lightning Bolt from the 2 Storm Adepts kills party members already hit by a Krolusk leap or Cytotoxin, so group them under Sigil of Silence and kick the next cast with Disrupt.
[위치] Gather the rest first, then pull Sand-Sworn Rider in with Throw Glaive once it nears the top of the bridge.
6: [차단] Group the 2 Brood Tenders and cover their Venom Bolt with Sigil of Silence, and stop Faithless Subjugator's Addle Mind (5 sec cast) with a single Disrupt.

[탱버] Serpent's Stormcall (8 sec of extra Nature damage on melee) from the 2 Lightning Serpents is not reduced by Demon Spikes, so pop Fiery Brand when they overlap and drag the mobs out of the Lingering Storm pools left behind.
